description: MAN TruckScenes is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "transportation", published or maintained by MAN Truck and Bus SE. A large scale multimodal dataset for Autonomous Trucking. Sensor data was recorded with a heavy truck from MAN equipped with 6 lidars, 6 radars, 4 cameras and a high-precision GNSS. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag transportation and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: The dataset may be updated with additional or corrected data on a need-to-update basis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
